title: Harkerware Currier & Ives "Homestead In Winter" 6 1/4" Saucer or Bread Plate
descriptionText: The Harkerware Currier & Ives "Homestead In Winter" 6 1/4" saucer or bread plate is a vintage collector plate featuring a round shape with a white and gold trim design. This pottery plate depicts a winter scene, perfect for the holiday season or winter-themed occasions. Made in the USA by the renowned brand Currier & Ives, this plate belongs to the Harkerware product line and is a great addition to any American culture or winter-themed collection.
